change.old_raw: About 5 working days at the embassy after authorised-agent submission
change.old_merged: 4 working days from acceptance of the application (Embassy of Japan in Russia)
change.new_value: Embassy of Japan/JVAC in Moscow: normally 4–5 working days; the mission describes 4 working days as a minimum. Its September 2026 notice warns that the Japanese holidays on 21–23 September may extend processing to 10 days including weekends. Apply well in advance; additional examination can take longer. For another consular jurisdiction in Russia, follow that office's published timing.

evidence.quote: с 21 по 23 сентября сроки рассмотрения визовых заявлений могут увеличиться до 10 дней, включая выходные.

за несколько недель до планируемой поездки.

raw_guidance.passport_validity: Valid for the duration of stay; six months remaining is recommended
raw_guidance.required_documents: passport, photo, visa application form, schedule of stay, flight/itinerary, accommodation proof, financial proof, employment/student certificate
raw_guidance.processing_time: About 5 working days at the embassy after authorised-agent submission
forms: One recent passport photo attached to form
raw_guidance.photo_requirements: One recent color photo, 45 mm x 35 mm, white/plain background, taken within 6 months, full face, no head covering unless religious
account_registration_steps: No personal online government account is required for the visa application; the accredited travel agent lodges it on your behalf
payment_process: Pay the official visa fee and the agency service fee to the accredited travel agent; the agent remits the consular fee to the Japanese Embassy/Consulate-General
submission_process: Prepare passport, completed form, photo, itinerary and supporting documents
Submit the application to an accredited travel agency/visa agent in your jurisdiction
The agency checks and forwards the application to the Japanese Embassy/Consulate-General
Collect your passport with the visa from the agency
raw_guidance.onward_travel_evidence: Confirmed round-trip flight itinerary or tickets showing entry and departure from Japan
raw_guidance.accommodation_evidence: Hotel bookings or other proof of lodging covering the entire stay
raw_guidance.financial_evidence: Bank statements, certificate of deposit, employment/income proof or tax documents showing sufficient funds
exceptions: 3-year multiple-entry visa is available only for applicants meeting financial-capacity and travel-history conditions
Package-tour participants may use simplified documents arranged by the accredited agency
Minors/students may use a parent/sponsor financial documents

uncertainty.reason: Japan-Russia diplomatic measures and consulate closures may restrict or suspend tourist visa issuance; confirm current status with the Embassy of Japan in Moscow or an authorised agent.
Standard single-entry fee is 3,000 JPY and multiple-entry is 6,000 JPY, but reciprocal or political changes could alter fees.
The list of authorised travel agencies and submission locations in Russia may have changed due to consulate closures; verify current agencies.

arrival_card.name: Visit Japan Web (VJW)
arrival_card.submission_window: Can be registered up to 6 months before entry; QR codes for immigration and customs should be completed before arrival/departure

health_requirements.name: Yellow fever vaccination certificate
health_requirements.trigger: Arrival within 6 days from or through a Japanese-designated yellow-fever endemic country

visa_products.notes: Standard tourist visa; actual granted stay depends on itinerary
For eligible frequent travelers; 30 days per visit

raw_guidance.application_channel_detail: Russian ordinary passport holders must lodge through a travel agency authorised by the Japanese Embassy in Russia. The agency submits the paper application to the Embassy of Japan in Moscow.

merged_guidance.application_channel_detail: For applications in Russia, submit at the Japan Visa Centre in person or through an authorised representative. The embassy does not accept visa applications by post.
